messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout starting for release/2026.03.14-rc1 -> serving-group canary-3 (10% traffic). Rollout id: rlt-9876. Triggered by @amanda. ETA 15m. /cc @oncall-sre
amanda: noticing error spike on canary dashboards — 502s from runtime, raising an incident. errors start ~2m after rollout.
oncall-sre: paging oncall rotation... @siddharth, you good?
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0314-1 severity:high -> paging rotation :rotating_light:
siddharth: on it, grabbing logs. can you confirm which commit landed? was there a tokenizer change?
jules: it was a tiny optimizer tweak + kv-cache touch, single commit `4f2a9d`. can revert quickly if needed.
amanda: customer-impact: a few dedicated tenants showed increased latency and ~5% failed requests. CS flagged Acme & ByteWave.
siddharth: confirmed — stacktrace shows segfault in kernel selection path (runtime->compile). repro'd on canary node locally.
jules: rolling kill-switch for feature flag `optimizer-v2` now. command: `./featflag kill optimizer-v2 --env canary`
jules: done — kill acknowledged. watching metrics.
amanda: errors dropped ~70% immediately, small tail remains but much improved. :thumbsup:
siddharth: prefer to revert the single commit from canary to be safe. executing fast revert:
```
git revert --no-commit 4f2a9d
./deploy canary --tag rlt-9876-revert-1 --no-promote
```
deploy-bot: Deploy started rlt-9876-revert-1 -> canary nodes (3/3) :rocket: 
ops-bot: NOTE: Pager duty escalation suppressed (auto) — no additional pages.
amanda: CS notified Acme & ByteWave: "we're mitigating, will follow up with RCA and ETA for prod rollout".
paul: I can prep a patch adding guard in kernel selector to avoid segfault; will open PR after revert.
siddharth: revert completed, canary now green across metrics. holding prod promotion for 30m smoke.
amanda: 30m hold scheduled. marking incident as 'hotfix-single-revert' temporarily closed but thread stays open.
oncall-sre: handoff: @siddharth -> @paul at 02:00 UTC. steps documented in INC-2026-0314-1 ticket.
customer-success: CS: both customers acknowledged and appreciate speed. asked for prod ETA and final RCA.
jules: filing RCA with diff, logs, and regression test plan. early hypothesis: optimizer-v2 didn't handle certain kv-cache seq len edge-case.
siddharth: monitoring for 60m then archive. reopen if anything spikes.
